toolchain.note: no root package.json; actions/setup/js and eslint-factory are independent npm projects

eslint.applies_to: actions/setup/js (via lint:setup-js script, config loaded from eslint-factory)
plugins: gh-aw-custom (local custom plugin built from eslint-factory/src)

ignore_patterns: **/*.test.js (excluded from main ruleset, has separate relaxed block)

payload.notes: ESLint flat config already exists with 71 custom rules targeting actions/setup/js; only one rule set to 'error' (require-http-response-error-listener), rest are 'warn'. New rules can be added to eslint-factory/src/rules and registered in eslint.config.cjs.
